title: RF-DETR: Neural Architecture Search for Real-Time Detection Transformers

problem.summary: Neural Architecture Search for DETRs faces unique challenges; existing approaches don't effectively target real-time performance with accuracy-latency trade-offs.
statements: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) for DETRs presents challenges distinct from CNNs.
Effectively balancing accuracy and latency for real-time DETRs remains difficult.

evidence.quote:
Rather than simply fine-tuning a heavyweight vision-language model (VLM) for new domains, we introduce RF-DETR,
a light-weight specialist detection transformer that discovers accuracy-latency
Pareto curves for any target dataset with weight-sharing neural architecture search
(NAS).

Our approach fine-tunes a pre-trained base network on a target dataset
and evaluates thousands of network configurations with different accuracy-latency
tradeoffs without re-training.

background.summary: Builds on DETR family and NAS; highlights the need to rethink NAS specifically for DETRs in real-time settings.

solution.approach: Tailor NAS search space and objectives specifically for real-time DETRs to discover Pareto-optimal architectures.
